generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Faithful clean redraw of the Stanley Motor Group wordmark in the reference, preserving exact name and black/white identity and its bold classic slab-serif character. Create a refined contemporary typographic logo, not a new automotive cliché: bold serif "STANLEY" with "MOTOR GROUP" beneath, and an isolated strong S letterform at far left as the compact matching mark. Keep a generous transparent gap between compact S and full wordmark. Transparent background, no black rectangle. Flat white and charcoal dual-ink letterforms with crisp dark edging and white outer keyline so the identical mark remains legible on white, charcoal and red backgrounds. Expert kerning, clean edges, no textures, no gradient, no shadow, no extra motif or tagline. Compact S must read clearly at 32px. Independent faithful redraw, not dealer approved.
